records.title: Cyber Security Engineer Graduate Scheme
records.notes: Existing tracker row J84 (found 2026-10-04 by Codex direct search). Marked Applied 2026-10-07 via application_state.py. Salary 48,500, 2-year programme starting Sep 2027, closes 29 Nov 2026. Clearance filter clean (no sponsorship available, no clearance or citizenship requirement). Fit 8.0: strong Python foundation (explicit requirement), security automation, detection logic, MITRE ATT&CK, JavaScript, Azure. Gaps: no Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform or CI/CD experience; cloud at foundational level. Note: same programme also listed as J117 (Manchester) - one application per programme.
